text:
marie: Quick thought — can we try a condensed 30m weekly triage next week? Proposal: keep it focused on backlog pruning + owner updates, and add a 10m 'quick fixes' slot at the top for tiny wins. frees up time for design reviews offline. Thoughts?

aj: Heads up — customer sync moved to 10:30 on Thu, would conflict if triage stays at 10:15. Could we move to 11:00 or do a split? @marie

sanjay: I prefer keeping it earlier. If we trim to 30m, 10:00–10:30 works for me. I can take owner for bug queue next week.

leila: 30m seems doable if we tighten the agenda and pre-seed owners. Suggest we publish a one-pager before the call with the top 8 tickets + owner and expected ask (info/block/fix). That way we can skip long context in the call.

marie: Good call. Example mini-agenda I had in mind: 
```
Agenda (30m)
- 5m quick fixes (quick status + owners)
- 15m high-priority bugs (owner updates, blockers)
- 5m rollouts / incidents / cross-team flags
- 5m actions & assignments
```
If we publish the ticket list 24h ahead we can reduce chatter. Also want a short slot every other week for RFC/design flags (5m) — only if there are asks.

aj: +1 on pre-seed doc. Could we use the existing triage doc (link: https://go/redwood/triage) and add a top table for quick items?

leila: I'll add a template to the doc. Quick template: `Ticket | Owner | ETA | Ask` — keeps the call moving.

deploy-bot: Scheduled reminder: weekly-triage set for Thu 10:00 — attendees: eng, eng-oncall. Next occurrence: 1871290000.

sanjay: I'll take next Fri's owner rota. ping @aj for CRs that might overlap with fixes so we don't block the quick slot.

aj: noted, I'll check the CRs and flag anything that needs triage. If 10:00 is firm for most, I'm good to shift customer sync if needed (will confirm).

marie: Sweet. Action items: (1) leila — add template and top-8 table to triage doc (due EOD Wed), (2) sanjay — own next week's bug queue, (3) aj — check CR conflicts and confirm by Wed. I'll post updated calendar invite for Thu 10:00 if no objections by tomorrow. :thumbsup:

leila: done — template added, left an example row.

aj: Confirmed — I can move my customer sync if needed. :+1:

marie: Thanks all. We'll trial 30m for two weeks and reassess. If anything urgent comes up we'll spin an ad-hoc deep-dive.

sidenote — pinging anyone doing RFC reviews this week: please add a 1-line summary to the triage doc under "RFC flags" so we can slot it in the alternate-week design spot.

end of thread.
